items.title: Inside a successful AWS European Sovereign Cloud exercise to demonstrate independent operation
items.summary: On Saturday, October 24, 2026 we conducted a successful exercise demonstrating that the AWS European Sovereign Cloud can operate without depending on any infrastructure outside the European Union (EU). This was the first public technical exercise demonstrating the independence of a sovereign cloud Region. The AWS European Sovereign Cloud is a new, independent cloud partition […]
